notes.title: Release as Early Access: July 25, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
 We are excited to announce "Hedgehog and Cat: Explore the World Action" will release into Early Access on July 25, 2025.

 we offer a 40% discount for the first two weeks (14 days) after the Early Access launch!



Early Access Release Date: July 25, 2025

Price: $11.99 USD 






[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3019770/"][/dynamiclink]





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065071/06a01016747ec4e06d34aaaacd6a9e036209f392.png"]


Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
 “We plan to gradually raise the price as we ship new content and features.”
